cover_headline: Democrats Pass 250 House Seats, Biggest Majority Since 2008 as Count Continues
facts: The Associated Press had called 253 races for Democrats and 155 for Republicans by Thursday afternoon, with 27 races still undecided
Amish Shah's flip in Arizona's 1st District delivered the party's 40th pickup of the cycle
At least 30 Republican incumbents have lost, including former Intelligence Committee chair Mike Turner and NRCC chair Richard Hudson

end.headline: Democrats Pass 250 House Seats, Biggest Majority Since 2008 as Count Continues
end.line: CNN projects Democrats past 250 seats after Amish Shah's Arizona flip, with the AP count at 253 and at least 30 Republican incumbents beaten.

quote.speaker: Sen. Ted Cruz
quote.role: US Senator, on the Republican losses, via Newsmax
